axes: Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y); asset front = Roblox LookVector (-Z); base on y = 0
surfaces: Every part has a 'surface': textured PBR from the BR_ sheets, embedded in the GLB as baseColorTexture / normalTexture (OpenGL +Y, tangent space) / metallicRoughnessTexture, with TANGENT, NORMAL and TEXCOORD_0 on every primitive. The 3D importer turns them into a SurfaceAppearance. If its packed-map conversion is poor, build the SurfaceAppearance by hand from textures/BuildingsReal/: ColorMap = colorMap, NormalMap = normalMap, RoughnessMap = roughnessMap (8-bit grayscale), MetalnessMap = metalnessMap (only parts that list one; leave it empty elsewhere), AlphaMode = alphaMode (glass only, with MeshPart.Transparency = meshTransparency; every other part ignores alpha). All parts are closed solids: DoubleSided false. 'rgb' is the average texture colour (MeshPart.Color fallback), 'robloxMaterial' the fallback material if no SurfaceAppearance is applied.

uploads.importer: the GLB embeds 15 images: BR_<Sheet>_Color / _Normal / _MR for Wood, Log, Stone, Shake, Kit (both BuildingsReal.glb and PropsReal.glb embed the same files - upload each PNG once and share the ids)
uploads.manual: 16 images: BR_<Sheet>_Color, BR_<Sheet>_Normal, BR_<Sheet>_Roughness (5 sheets) + BR_Kit_Metal

texelDensityUnits: pixels per stud on the 1024 sheets (logs 164, boards / shakes 160, masonry 200, bark 196, canvas 128; end-grain discs 100)

assets.name: HunterCabin
assets.notes: Trapper's log cabin. Door (4 x 7.5 opening) centre front (+Y) under a porch; windows front-left and back-right; fireplace in the east gable (Hearth attachment); loft over the west third, floor top 10.9, reached by a pole ladder: place a 2x10x2 TrussPart (Transparency 1) from LadderBase up to LadderTop (the ladder mesh is visual only). Roof slabs are Hull; shakes, trim, glass, ropes and furniture details do not collide.

assets.name: Watchtower
assets.notes: Timber fire lookout. Deck top z = 22 (four Box plank groups) with a 2.5 x 2.5 ladder well at x 0.5..3.0, y -3.0..-0.5: place a 2x22x2 TrussPart (Transparency 1) from LadderBase to LadderTop; the pole ladder is visual only. Walk in through the open front (+Y) bottom bay. Roof is Hull; bolts, joists, roof frame and shakes do not collide.

assets.name: Footbridge
assets.notes: Plank-and-rope suspension footbridge spanning X: EndA (x -20) and EndB (x +20) at deck level 1.5 on the banks, deck 4.6 wide, 1.2 sag at mid-span. Five Hull plank segments are the walkable deck; ropes, cables, hangers do not collide (nothing stops a fall off the side). Sink the crib sills and bank stones into the bank; the deadman logs lie at x = +-23.8.
